title: Archytan Lite callers.json
description: Binds each caller's credential to the single role (and optional tenant) it holds. Never store a raw token here -- token_sha256 is the hex-encoded SHA-256 digest, generated by cmd/callergen or cmd/onboard, never hand-typed. See internal/authn/caller.go.

callers.description: Every registered credential. A gate with none registered refuses to start.

caller_id.description: A human-readable identifier for this credential, e.g. "agent-invoices". Must be unique across the file, with no leading or trailing whitespace.

role.description: The single role this caller holds. Must match a role named in some action's allowed_roles in policy.json, or this caller can never be authorized to do anything -- see cmd/policylint.

tenant.description: The organizational boundary this credential belongs to. Required only if any action this caller's role can reach asserts tenant_match; omit otherwise.

token_sha256.description: The hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the bearer token -- 64 lowercase hex characters, never the raw token itself. Generate with cmd/callergen or cmd/onboard; do not hand-author.
